source: NIST CAVP, SHA-3 byte-oriented test vectors (CAVS 19.0, generated 2016-01-28): https://csrc.nist.gov/CSRC/media/Projects/Cryptographic-Algorithm-Validation-Program/documents/sha3/sha-3bytetestvectors.zip (SHA-256 of the zip: cd07701af2e47f5cc889d642528b4bf11f8b6eb55797c7307a96828ed8d8fc8c) and https://csrc.nist.gov/CSRC/media/Projects/Cryptographic-Algorithm-Validation-Program/documents/sha3/shakebytetestvectors.zip (SHA-256 of the zip: debfebc3157b3ceea002b84ca38476420389a3bf7e97dc5f53ea4689a16de4c7)
licence: US Government work (NIST), public domain in the US
filter: Messages of at most 200 bytes (Len <= 1600 bits) only; the ShortMsg files go up to one or two rate blocks (e.g. 2688 bits for SHAKE128), the longer ones are dropped. CAVP Len is in bits; the Len = 0 case's placeholder "Msg = 00" is stored as the empty message. VariableOut: every message is 16 (SHAKE128) or 32 (SHAKE256) bytes so all cases are kept, each with its own output length (Outputlen bits / 8; all are whole bytes). Hex copied unchanged, lower-cased.
